title: arc_os knowledge pack manifest
description: /packs/<name>/manifest.json (ADR-0011, knowledge-os.md section 6), written by the host pipeline. It is also the `pack` object of a pack .arcpkg manifest. The pack name is the first part of every chunk ID (pack:document:chunk-number).

version.description: Chunk IDs are stable within a pack version; every derived index records the version it was built from.

category.description: Library section the pack belongs to (e.g. medical, repair, encyclopedia).

priority.description: Install and search order when space or time is short: lower comes first.

size_bytes.description: Installed size of the pack directory.

checksums.description: SHA-256 of every file in the pack, by path relative to the pack directory.

provides.description: Indexes the pack ships: `fts` (fts/, SQLite FTS5) and one `vectors/<embedder-id>` per embedder (ADR-0011). `fts` is required: search works without the LLM (ADR-0015).

chunking.description: How the documents were cut into chunks (ADR-0011: ~300-500 tokens of plain UTF-8 text).

chunk_count.description: Chunks in this pack version; every derived index records the count it was built from.

domain_tags.description: Domain tags in bit order: tag i is bit i of each chunk record's domain-tag bitmask (64 bits). Routers use them to pick an expert model.
